description: DATASET-Effect of Multiscale Metro Network-wide Attributes on Peak-Hour Station Passenger and Flow Balancing is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Miao Hu. The data used in the academic paper titled "Effect of Multiscale Metro Network-wide Attributes on Peak-Hour Station Passenger and Flow Balancing" in the Journal of Transport and Land Use. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1147085811 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
